set.tovw: Box of ~$1,500 buried 1858; six $20 pieces found 1875; rest unaccounted. One wire item (Milwaukee Wisconsin, copied by the State Journal and Manitowoc Tribune)
Hoard found by the family 1892, nearly $18,000
set.n: Mrs. Tony (Torena) Gregg's hidden money, Town of Dover
set.pl: Gregg farm, Town of Dover (Racine Co.); pin on the town centroid, farm not yet placed
set.st: Mrs. Tony (Torena) Gregg of the Town of Dover died in Nov 1892 leaving $8,000 in a Mitchell bank and money hidden around the farm: $1,500 in a lard jar in the cellar, about $1,000 in rags, $1,000 in a pantry box, and more dug from the woodshed and outbuildings, nearly $18,000 in all. Her husband Wm. Gregg died in June 1893 aged 77. Pin is approximate (town centroid), not the farm.
set.t: Found by the family in 1892: record only. Access: private.
